_doc: Frosting candy ground of the Candy Kingdom (bead bzc.115, docs/art/classes/grounds.md). Lessons of grounds-volcanic, -snow and -sand: no chibi style layer (it turns a field into a character), never the words texture or tile (pixflux draws a paving grid), a long-period base from pixflux at 400 x 400 (5 cells), no fragments at all. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead. '@name' values come from shared.

shared.icing: Subject: a wide smooth field of soft pale pink strawberry icing seen from straight above, filling the whole image edge to edge: smooth pale pink icing #f2c4d4 with broad soft swirls and gentle spread ridges in slightly lighter cream pink #fbdde6 and slightly darker #e4abc0, like frosting smoothed over a huge cake with a palette knife, very calm, quiet and low in contrast, the same everywhere.
shared.sprinkled: Subject: a wide smooth field of soft pale pink strawberry icing seen from straight above, filling the whole image edge to edge: smooth pale pink icing #f2c4d4 with broad soft swirls in slightly lighter cream pink #fbdde6 and slightly darker #e4abc0, and very few tiny short candy sprinkles scattered far apart, a few mint #7fd6b5, a few lemon #f4d46c, a few white, very calm, quiet and low in contrast, the same everywhere.
shared.spread: Subject: smooth soft pale pink strawberry icing spread flat, seen from straight above, filling the whole image edge to edge: even pale pink icing #f0c2d2 with many fine thin wavy palette-knife lines in slightly lighter cream pink #f9d8e2 and slightly darker #e6b0c4, the lines short, wavy and running in many slightly different directions, very calm and low in contrast, no single big swirl, no spiral, no light spot, the same everywhere.
shared.smooth: Subject: a wide flat field of smooth fresh pink icing seen from directly above, filling the whole image edge to edge: soft pale pink #f2c8d6 with large soft, slightly deeper pink drifts #eab6c8 that blend gently into each other and a few faint thin curved cream lines #f8dce6, very calm, quiet and low in contrast, the same everywhere.
